answer: Time-locked relay berths. Each identity gets a slot on a shared jetty, but slots open only after a long scheduled voyage of relaying real traffic under audit. An attacker must staff each fake identity for that full window, spending sustained compute and uptime rather than one payment. Yarrow-stained challenge packets verify relays ran continuously. Scaling fakes multiplies the wait and labor linearly, so the per-identity cost is months of honest work.
